summary_en: Macnica Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 1.6 million shares (0.89% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 5 billion yen through market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 4 to December 21, 2026, aligned with the medium-term management plan targeting 40–50% total shareholder return including stable dividends based on 5% DOE.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 2, 2026, Macnica Holdings' board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under the Articles of Incorporation pursuant to the Company Law Article 165. The company will acquire up to 1.6 million shares for a maximum of 5 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 4 and December 21, 2026.

The acquisition represents 0.89% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) as of September 30, 2026, when 178.66 million shares were outstanding. The company stated that the buyback aligns with its fundamental shareholder return policy under the 2025–2027 medium-term management plan, which targets 40–50% total shareholder return through a combination of stable dividend distribution based on a DOE of approximately 5% and opportunistic treasury stock repurchases, while securing internal reserves for business development and strengthening operational efficiency.
